info.title: Comet Creator Publishing API
info.description: Server-to-server partner page authoring API, alongside the existing Publisher GraphQL API. Implementation defaults disabled; obtain the approved environment origin, IAM APP_CLIENT credential and scoped grant from Comet. Do not send Authorization headers or browser credentials. This spec covers authoring and event polling; public reader/operator endpoints and signup delivery are outside its scope. Content schema versions 1 and 2 are supported; the outer response envelope remains schemaVersion 1.

servers.description: Replace the reserved placeholder with your operator-provided integration origin. No live host is implied.

put.description: Requires creator:bind. No request body is needed. Does not provision a grant or create a global creator identity.

get.summary: Discover current operations and content versions
get.description: Requires page:read. May be called before binding. The legacy content descriptor is v1; contentVersions also advertises v2, currently preferred.
Requires page:read. Requires active binding. IDs sort lexicographically, not chronologically. Start a fresh listing to discover concurrent insertions before a cursor.

get.summary: Read an exact saved draft preview
get.description: Requires page:read. Rejects stale versions. Returns content and digest, not an HTML preview, public URL or credential.

post.description: Requires page:publish. Requires exact draft, active revision, publication version and digest. Publication readiness is enforced. Hosting registration is separate; reread GET page for publicUrl.

get.description: Requires page:read. Only the current active revision is readable here. This authenticated route does not provide public hosting or arbitrary history access.

get.summary: Poll durable lifecycle and publication events
get.description: Requires events:read. Returns a raw array, ascending realm-local sequence. Persist event IDs and cursor with consumer updates. No server acknowledgement endpoint. Separate event-reader grant supports terminal lifecycle reads while a realm is inactive.

CometAppKey.name: x-api-key
CometAppKey.description: Server-held IAM APP_CLIENT API key with an explicit scoped grant. JWT/Authorization headers are rejected.

GrantGeneration.name: x-grant-generation
GrantGeneration.description: Current operator-provisioned grant generation; numeric value must be a nonnegative safe integer.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Reuse the exact key and payload after an ambiguous write. Scoped to principal, realm, operation and page; current authority is rechecked.

Content.description: Versioned content, bounded to 256 KiB. Use capability discovery. Semantic URL, markup, identity-uniqueness, UTF-16 length, depth and publication readiness checks remain authoritative on the server.

Error.description: Application error envelope. Ingress/body-parser failures may use a different envelope.

UnpublishPage.description: digest is not required or used for unpublish; omit it. It is accepted by the shared command parser.

ContentV2.description: Structural schema extracted from the merged generated backend contract. Semantic refinements are enforced by parseContentV2 and validatePublicationV2; this schema alone does not prove publication readiness.

publicUrl.description: Current canonical HTTPS URL, or null when no eligible public route/publication exists. Only GET page returns this field; reread after mutations.

jsonSchema.description: Available on v2; structural JSON Schema with semantic checks enforced separately.

ContentDescriptor.description: Extensible discovery metadata, including limits, field descriptors or JSON Schema, and publication requirements. Do not treat v1 field descriptors as JSON Schema.

eventType.description: Examples: creator.bound, page.published, page.unpublished, authoring-grant.revoked, creator.suspended, creator.reactivated, page.route-renamed.

401.description: UNAUTHENTICATED: missing or invalid app credential, or unsupported Authorization header.

403.description: Current grant, creator or realm authority does not allow this operation.

404.description: Scoped resource is absent or unavailable.

409.description: VERSION_CONFLICT, PREVIEW_CONFLICT, IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT or another binding/state conflict.

413.description: Payload exceeds 256 KiB. Ingress parser failures may use a different envelope.

422.description: CONTENT_NOT_READY: visible content is not ready for publication.
